# Asset briefs

**Status: draft.** Every asset below already exists in the repository or is generated by an existing,
committed script. This file does not request new artwork, new capture sessions, or a new build
pipeline — it specifies how to crop, caption, and describe the assets that
[`CONTENT_CALENDAR.md`](CONTENT_CALENDAR.md) references so they stay accessible and legible across
formats.

## Source assets

| Asset | Format | Location | Regenerate with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Graph social cards | 1200 × 630 | `apps/docs/public/og/` | `pnpm --filter @santi020k/lumen-docs run generate:og` |
| One screen, three web targets | 16:9 landscape + 9:16 vertical | `apps/docs/public/launch/one-screen-three-web-targets.mp4` / `-vertical.mp4` | `bash apps/docs/scripts/generate-launch-videos.sh` |
| Prompt to verified UI | 16:9 landscape + 9:16 vertical | `apps/docs/public/launch/prompt-to-verified-ui.mp4` / `-vertical.mp4` | Same script |
| Figma to native foundations | 16:9 landscape + 9:16 vertical | `apps/docs/public/launch/figma-to-native-foundations.mp4` / `-vertical.mp4` | Same script |
| Instagram profile image | 512 × 512 PNG | `apps/docs/public/icon-512.png` | Existing brand export; do not redraw |
| Instagram introduction carousel | Five 1080 × 1080 PNGs | `apps/docs/public/launch/instagram/lumen-introduction/` | `node apps/docs/scripts/render-instagram-introduction.mjs` |

The video generator requires FFmpeg, builds temporary campaign cards from the existing Open Graph
renderer, and removes its own temporary files — see
[`apps/docs/public/launch/README.md`](../../apps/docs/public/launch/README.md). Do not hand-edit the
rendered `.mp4` files; change the underlying card content and regenerate instead.

## Format specifications

### 1200 × 630 social image (landscape, link-preview crop)

- Keep the primary sentence and one real product screen; do not add a second competing headline.
- Text must sit inside a centered 1100 × 530 safe area so link-preview surfaces that crop the edges
  do not clip words.
- Use only the token palette in [`docs/brand-guidelines.md`](../brand-guidelines.md) — no ad hoc
  colors.
- Alt text: describe the visible interface and the one claim being made, e.g. "Lumen settings screen
  built with Astro, React, and Web Components primitives sharing the same tokens."

### 16:9 landscape video

- Center the interaction inside a 1:1 safe area in the middle of the frame; some destinations letterbox
  or crop landscape video to near-square.
- Burn in captions; do not rely on a separate subtitle track that a destination might drop.
- Keep motion calm and legible per [`docs/brand-guidelines.md`](../brand-guidelines.md#motion): no
  rapid cuts, no marquee or auto-scrolling text.
- Show a visible keyboard focus ring whenever the script demonstrates keyboard interaction.
- End on the canonical guide URL from [`CONTENT_KIT.md`](CONTENT_KIT.md)'s CTA table, never a
  shortened or vendor-tracked link.

### 9:16 vertical crop

- Reframe the same source recording; do not re-shoot with different content or claims.
- Keep all on-screen text inside the center 1080 × 1520 region of the 1080 × 1920 frame — the top and
  bottom ~200px are commonly obscured by a destination's own UI chrome (profile bar, caption area,
  action buttons).
- Captions must remain inside that same safe area.
- Provide a text alternative (the caption track or a written summary) alongside the file; do not ship
  a caption-only video with no separate description for screen-reader users browsing the page that
  embeds it.

### Instagram square carousel

- Export at 1080 × 1080 and keep text inside the center 900 × 900 region. Preview the final asset in
  Instagram before publication because UI overlays and profile-grid crops can change.
- Start with a complete outcome, follow with no more than four evidence frames, and end with one CTA.
- Use a real Lumen product screen or workflow; do not build a quote-only carousel.
- The localization carousel stays English-first and uses the EN/ES toggle as evidence, not as a claim
  that all Lumen content is translated.

## Accessibility checklist (apply to every asset before it enters the queue)

- [ ] Alt text or a caption track describes the visible interface and the interaction, not just the
      product name.
- [ ] Color is never the only way a state (success, error, focus) is conveyed.
- [ ] Captions are burned in or shipped as an equally discoverable text alternative; nothing important
      is audio-only.
- [ ] Motion honors `prefers-reduced-motion` in any live capture and avoids rapid, flashing cuts in
      recorded video.
- [ ] Text remains legible at the smallest size the destination is likely to render it.
- [ ] The exact package, CLI, or skill-install command shown on screen matches the current root
      `README.md` verbatim.

## What is out of scope here

- Platform-specific crop presets for channels that are still deferred in
  [`CHANNELS.md`](CHANNELS.md). Add a row only after the channel is approved.
- New screenshot capture sessions. Reuse the existing docs-app Open Graph renderer and launch videos;
  playground screenshot sets change frequently and are tracked separately, not by this package.
